Surprise

Adrien Taudiere

2026-06-22

Source: vignettes/surprise.Rmd
surprise.Rmd

/! Work in progress /!

In this vignette we will explore the notion of “Bayesian surprise” applied to the presence of a given taxa in our sample(s). The idea is to quantify how surprising, (the ratio between prior and posterior probabilities) it is to find a given taxa in a given location.
